challenge.results: An inaccurate dataset is consistent with an as-is offer. The clause makes no finding about whether errors exist. It does not determine the effect of a warranty given in a separate contract. If applicable law restricts disclaimer, section 4(b) expressly limits the disclaimer to the extent that law permits.

limitations: Application of CC0 to a particular Work, the Work’s actual accuracy or title, the terms of any separate assurance, and enforceability under a particular law require separate evidence.
